name: Cassandra Blackwood

abilities.name: Blade Strike
abilities.description: A sword strike enhanced with crackling magical energy

abilities.name: Arcane Shield
abilities.description: Conjures a personal barrier that absorbs incoming damage

abilities.name: Drain Essence
abilities.description: Siphons life force from a target to restore own vitality

appearance.hair: raven black, kept in a practical braid
appearance.distinctive_features: Always impeccably dressed despite travel, silver rings on every finger, predatory smile

personality.demeanor: Charming and confident, treats interactions as negotiations, maintains emotional distance
personality.speaking_style: Articulate and persuasive, uses flattery strategically, never raises voice but words cut deep

beliefs: Power is the only currency that matters
Sentiment is a luxury for those who can afford weakness
Every person is either useful, profitable, or irrelevant
philosophy.approach_to_conflict: Calculates risk versus reward before engaging. Prefers to manipulate others into fighting her battles. When forced to fight, uses magic to control the battlefield while staying safe. Will abandon allies without hesitation if survival or greater gain requires it. Never fights fair if she can avoid it.

visible: Reinforced leather armor disguised as fine traveling clothes
hidden: Small fortune in gems sewn into jacket lining

secrets: Murdered her mentor to steal his research on life-extension magic
Wanted by the Mage's Council for forbidden experimentation
Has no loyalty to anyone and views all relationships as temporary alliances of convenience
backstory: Born to minor nobility, Cassandra showed magical talent early and was apprenticed to a renowned battlemage. Brilliant but ruthless, she killed her mentor when he refused to share his most powerful secrets. Now operates as a mercenary mage, taking contracts that advance her twin goals: accumulating power and extending her lifespan. Views morality as a constraint for the weak.
